title: Informed Consent
description: The user may not be fully aware of what data is being collected by the wearable device, leading to a lack of informed consent regarding the data sharing.

title: Data Integrity
description: The wearable device may not ensure the integrity of the data collected, leading to potential inaccuracies in the telemetry data that could affect user health assessments.

title: Data Disclosure
description: The wearable device may inadvertently disclose sensitive user data (e.g., GPS location) to unauthorized parties during data transmission or storage.

title: Data Disclosure from Wearable Device
description: The wearable device may unintentionally disclose personal data such as exercise sessions, GPS traces, and device ID when syncing with the companion app, potentially exposing this data to unauthorized parties.

title: Data Disclosure at Companion App
description: The companion app may store or process the received data in a way that could lead to unauthorized access or sharing of personal data, such as exercise sessions and GPS traces, with third parties.

title: Unawareness of Data Sharing
description: The user may not be fully aware that their personal data (calorie intake, meals, weight) is being shared with the Companion Mobile App, leading to potential unintentional sharing of sensitive information.

title: Lack of User Consent
description: The app may collect and store health logs without obtaining explicit consent from the user, leading to a lack of transparency regarding data usage.

title: Data Disclosure Risk
description: The health log store may inadvertently disclose personal health data to unauthorized parties, either through data breaches or improper access controls.

title: Data Disclosure of GPS Location
description: The Companion Mobile App collects and writes GPS location traces with timestamps to the Location History Store, which may lead to the unintended disclosure of personal location data if not properly secured or if access controls are inadequate.

title: Data Disclosure of Stored Location Data
description: The Location History Store may expose stored GPS location data to unauthorized access or sharing, leading to potential privacy violations if the data is not adequately protected.

title: Data Disclosure from Health Log Store
description: The Health Log Store (DataStore) may disclose personal health data (calorie, weight, exercise logs) to the Health Analytics Service (Process) without proper consent or minimality principles being applied, leading to potential unauthorized access or sharing of sensitive information.

title: Data Disclosure by Health Analytics Service
description: The Health Analytics Service (Process) may process and analyze personal health data in a way that leads to unintended disclosures, either through derived data or by sharing insights with third parties without proper safeguards or user consent.

title: Data Disclosure of Location History
description: The location history data being shared from the Location History Store (DS2) to the Health Analytics Service (P3) may lead to the disclosure of personal data, including sensitive information about an individual's daily routines and movement patterns. This could happen either explicitly through the analytics service's queries or implicitly through derived insights from the data.

title: Inadequate Data Anonymization
description: The Health Analytics Service (P3) may inadequately anonymize or aggregate the location data received from the Location History Store (DS2), leading to potential identification of individuals based on their movement patterns. This could result in privacy violations if the data is not properly handled.

title: Identifying Data Subject through Inferred Insights
description: The Health Analytics Service may inadvertently reveal the identity of a data subject through the inferred insights it provides to the Companion Mobile App, especially if the insights are specific enough to be linked back to an individual.

title: Profiling a Group of Individuals
description: The Companion Mobile App may use the inferred insights to profile a group of individuals, leading to potential privacy risks for those not directly involved in the data flow, as insights about one individual could lead to conclusions about others in the same demographic or health condition.

title: Insufficient Cybersecurity Risk Management
description: The Companion Mobile App may not have adequate cybersecurity measures in place to protect the inferred insights, leading to potential non-compliance with privacy regulations and exposing sensitive health data to unauthorized access.

title: Linkability of User Data
description: The app may link user data to specific individuals, potentially allowing for identification of users based on their health trends and inferred condition indicators.

title: Data Disclosure to Unauthorized Parties
description: The user may inadvertently disclose sensitive health information to unauthorized parties if the app does not implement proper access controls or if the user shares their device with others.

title: Non-compliance with Health Data Regulations
description: The app may not comply with relevant health data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR), leading to potential legal risks and penalties for mishandling user health information.

title: Data Disclosure to Cloud Provider
description: The health analytics service shares sensitive health and location data with the cloud hosting provider, which may lead to unintended data disclosure if the provider does not have adequate security measures in place.

title: Data Disclosure by Cloud Provider
description: The cloud hosting provider may inadvertently disclose the hosted health analytics data to unauthorized parties, either through inadequate access controls or data breaches.
